source_context.summary: Trial 3 identity-reconciliation stress test over the admitted Trial 2 state. Exercises exact canonical reuse, semantic paraphrase reuse, similar-but-distinct propositions, multi-source convergence on one proposition, and uncertainty resolution through contradiction plus supersession.

records.statement: A standing RGP Admission Proof workflow exists and can replay validation and deterministic admission proof generation without installing canonical PEMS/COVE state.
A standing RGP Admission Proof workflow is available to replay RGP validation and deterministic admission-proof generation without writing canonical PEMS/COVE state.
A branch-local immutable proof-request workflow successfully executed the Trial 2 non-no-op admission proof on project-chat-handoff without itself installing canonical PEMS/COVE state.
Whether the standing RGP Admission Proof workflow preserves its guarantees for a novel non-no-op admission transaction remains unverified.

The Trial 2 novel non-no-op admission transaction completed a successful deterministic admission proof with valid PEMS/2 output, graph integrity, deterministic PEMS/COVE bytes, and a successful COVE structural round trip.
Trial 2's real non-no-op transaction passed the deterministic RGP-to-PEMS/2 admission proof, including graph-integrity and COVE/JCS round-trip checks.
The successful Trial 2 candidate PEMS/2 and COVE bytes were persisted under immutable RGP evidence before the Steward installed those exact blobs as canonical memory.
